verified_facts.text: The resort is in Aventura, Florida, a city that began with a country club 12 miles north of Miami.
verified_facts.excerpt: The city of Aventura, Spanish for “adventure”, began with a prestigious country club, 12 miles north of Miami

verified_facts.text: The resort spreads across a 300-acre setting with Mediterranean-inspired architecture, marble walkways and fountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: Across our 300-acre setting, you’ll find Mediterranean-inspired architecture, marble walkways, and sparkling fountains.

verified_facts.text: The grounds include lush tropical gardens and a 100-year-old banyan tree.
verified_facts.excerpt: A celebrated setting in Miami complete with lush tropical gardens and a 100-year-old Banyan tree

verified_facts.text: The grounds are a sanctuary to over 40 species of tropical birds, with a chef's herb garden and a tropical fruit garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: A sanctuary to over 40 species of tropical birds, botanical fauna, chef’s herb, and tropical fruit garden.

verified_facts.text: Turnberry was at the core of Don Soffer's vision for present-day Aventura, a city planned out on a cocktail napkin.
verified_facts.excerpt: Turnberry was at the core of Don Soffer's vision of present-day Aventura - a city that was planned out on a cocktail napkin by Don himself.

verified_facts.text: The resort continues to be owned and managed by the Soffer family.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Resort continues to be owned and managed by the Soffer family.

verified_facts.text: The interior design takes inspiration from Miami's art-deco history, with clean, geometric lines.
verified_facts.excerpt: The standout interior design took inspiration from Miami’s art-deco history presenting clean, geometric lines

verified_facts.text: Every guest room and suite has a private furnished balcony or terrace, with views of foliage, the ocean, the golf courses or the pools.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each features a private furnished balcony or terrace affording stunning views of lush Florida foliage in Aventura, the ocean, two championship Turnberry Isle golf courses, or beautifully landscaped pools.

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites have marble bathrooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: spacious rooms and suites provide relaxing comfort with marble bathrooms and private balconies overlooking the Resort's tropical grounds.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows.
verified_facts.excerpt: All have furnished balconies or terraces and floor-to-ceiling windows

verified_facts.text: The resort has two 18-hole championship golf courses, the Soffer and the Miller, designed by Robert Trent Jones, Sr. and reimagined by World Golf Hall of Famer Raymond Floyd.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our two legendary 18-hole championship golf courses in Aventura, were designed by Robert Trent Jones, Sr., and reimagined by World Golf Hall of Famer Raymond Floyd.

verified_facts.text: The Soffer and Miller courses have hosted numerous Florida PGA and LPGA championships.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Soffer and Miller courses have hosted numerous Florida PGA and LPGA championships.

verified_facts.text: The Soffer Course finishes with a par-four 18th hole on a peninsula green.
verified_facts.excerpt: When you reach 18, prepare for a par four that tests your fortitude with a picturesque Peninsula Green sitting on a legendary finishing hole.

verified_facts.text: On the Miller Course, pink flamingos nest on Lake Julius, named for US Open champion Julius Boros.
verified_facts.excerpt: Try not to be distracted by the pink flamingos nesting on Lake Julius – named for Julius Boros, US Open Champion and our first Director of Golf.

verified_facts.text: Tidal Cove Waterpark has a 60-foot tower with seven water slides, a kids pool with an aquatic play structure and 25 private cabanas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tidal Cove Waterpark features a 60-foot tower with seven water slides, a 4,000-square-foot kids pool with an aquatic play structure, the first-ever FlowRider® Triple in the nation, 25 private cabanas

verified_facts.text: Tidal Cove has the nation's first FlowRider Triple.
verified_facts.excerpt: Learn how to ride the waves in the nation's first ever FlowRider® Triple

verified_facts.text: Tidal Cove Waterpark is complimentary for two guests per room daily.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tidal Cove Waterpark is a complimentary amenity for two (2) guests per room daily at JW Marriott Miami Turnberry Resort & Spa.

verified_facts.text: Tidal Cove offers daily activities for children 12 and under, such as hair braiding and arts and crafts.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join the fun at Tidal Cove offering daily activities for children 12 and under. Our recreation team members have curated an action-packed day full of Hair Braiding, Arts & Crafts

verified_facts.text: The Spa & Wellness Center spans three stories.
verified_facts.excerpt: From world-class Golf and our 5-acre Tidal Cove Waterpark, to our expansive 3-story Spa & Wellness Center

verified_facts.text: The spa offers Babor treatments and Himalayan salt rooms, alongside a center for integrative and holistic medicine.
verified_facts.excerpt: the three-story wellness area features a huge gym, a center for integrative and holistic medicine, fitness programs, and a spa offering Babor treatments and Himalayan salt rooms

verified_facts.text: Turnberry Isle Racquet Club has five tournament-grade courts, three for pickleball and two for padel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Turnberry Isle Racquet Club features five tournament-grade courts—three dedicated to pickleball, and two padel.

verified_facts.text: The 3.1-mile Don Soffer Exercise Trail circles the golf course along Country Club Drive.
verified_facts.excerpt: The 3.1 mile exercise path circles our JW Marriott Turnberry Miami Golf Course along Country Club Drive.

verified_facts.text: Bourbon Steak by Michael Mina is a steakhouse with a wood-burning grill serving steak and fresh seafood.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our award-winning steakhouse features a wood-burning grill and serves perfectly prepared cuts of steak, fresh seafood

verified_facts.text: Aventura Mall is a seven-minute walk from the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: The shops and restaurants of the Aventura Mall are just a seven-minute walk away.

verified_facts.text: The resort is not on a beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: feels like you’ve landed on a tropical island (albeit one without a beach)

verified_facts.text: The resort's pools and waterpark are also open to day-pass guests, so poolside loungers can be in demand.
verified_facts.excerpt: with the resort’s pools and on-site water park also open to day-pass guests (and no priorities given to hotel guests)
